1  ORDER
The petitioners are the accused Nos.1 to 3 in CC No.199 of 2021 on the files of the Judicial First Class Magistrate Court-IV, Kozhikode.

entities.text: Judicial First Class Magistrate Court-IV, Kozhikode
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: They face criminal prosecution for the commission of offences under Sections 498A and 406 IPC r/w Section 34 IPC and Section 75 of the Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection of Children) Act, 2015.

entities.text: Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection of Children) Act, 2015
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 2. In the present petition, the petitioners would contend that the issue involved in this case, has been amicably settled with the de facto complainant and the other aggrieved person, and hence the proceedings against the petitioners are liable to be quashed.
3. Heard the learned counsel for the petitioners, the learned counsel for the respondents 2 and 3 and the learned Public Prosecutor representing the State of Kerala.

4. The de facto complainant and the other aggrieved person have filed affidavits before this Court,
stating that the issue has been amicably settled with the petitioners, and hence they are not interested in continuing the proceedings against the petitioners.
2025:KER:74611 Crl.M.C 9411 of 2024 5.

The learned Public Prosecutor, upon instructions, submitted that the de facto complainant and the other aggrieved person had given statements to the Investigating Officer also, to the effect that the issue has been amicably settled with the petitioners, and hence they are not interested in continuing the criminal prosecution against the petitioners.

6. Though the offence under Section 75 of the Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection of Children)
Act, 2015, has been incorporated in the Final Report, it is seen that no serious injuries have been suffered by the child, who is said to have been assaulted by the petitioners.

entities.text:
Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection of Children)
Act, 2015
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Hence, the inclusion of Section 75 of the JJ Act in the Final Report is not a reason to disallow the prayer to quash the proceedings.
7. The issue involved in this case is purely private in nature.
Now that it has been amicably settled between the parties.

Having regard to the above facts and circumstances of the case, I am of the view that no purpose would be fulfilled by the continuance of the prosecution against the petitioners, and hence it is highly necessary to terminate the prosecution proceedings to prevent abuse of process of court.
Such a course is also required to maintain the harmonious relationship between the parties.
Therefore, the prayer in this petition to quash the proceedings 2025:KER:74611 Crl.M.C 9411 of 2024 against the petitioners, has to be allowed.
In the result, the petition stands allowed.

The proceedings against the petitioners/accused Nos.1 to 3 in CC No.199 of 2021 on the files of the Judicial First Class Magistrate Court-IV, Kozhikode, which arose out of Crime No.332/2019 of Vellayil Police Station, Kozhikode, are hereby quashed.
